remarks: Welcome to Bradley Commons, a private gated enclave in the heart of Westport's vibrant Saugatuck neighborhood-just minutes to the train, Compo Beach, top-rated schools, and premier dining and shopping.  This exceptional end-unit townhome features a bright open floor plan with hardwood floors, high ceilings, and abundant natural light. The chef's kitchen offers granite countertops, gas range, French door refrigerator, large pantry, and breakfast bar, flowing seamlessly into the dining area with sliders to a private deck-ideal for entertaining.  The sun-filled living room with eastern exposure includes a gas fireplace, powder room, and generous closet space. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite boasts walk-in closets and a luxurious ensuite bath with double vanity and oversized shower. A second en-suite bedroom and upper-level laundry provide comfort and convenience.  The versatile lower level is perfect for a guest suite, office, gym, or den, with direct access to a private patio and yard, plus ample storage and entry to the attached one-car garage.  Beautifully maintained with professional landscaping and abundant guest parking, Bradley Commons offers turnkey living in an unbeatable location.
